trans-unit.source: API key for the MCP connection: Clicking the button creates a new key. Copy it right away, it will not be shown in the backend again. Important: the uid of the user has to be put in front, for user 4 that is "4.AbC123…". Note: a new key can also be created on the command line (in2mcp:apikey <uid>). It is printed there with the uid already in front, and the previous key stops working.
Use MCP clients with an api key
Members of this group may connect MCP clients like Claude or ChatGPT with their api key and work within their permissions. Without this option an api key is refused. Administrators always may.
